## Why This Is Asked
Evaluates ability to design a scalable, governed self-serve analytics layer across many tenants while preserving data privacy and cost control.

## Key Concepts
- Multi-tenant data mesh with per-tenant isolation
- Fine-grained access control via Lake Formation
- Dynamic data masking and catalog partitioning
- OpenTelemetry visibility across ingestion and queries
- Cost control via partition pruning and lifecycle rules

```javascript
{

  \"Statement\": [{

    \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:athena:*:*:workgroup/tenant-*\",\"arn:aws:s3:::telemetry-tenant-*/*\",\"arn:aws:glue:*:*:catalog\"]
  }]
}
```

- How would you validate masking policies without impacting legitimate analysts?
- How would schema changes across tenants be evolved without breaking existing dashboards?
